description: This Java interface defines a builder for creating responses and events related to modifying feature properties in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides factory methods for responses indicating creation, modification, or errors, as well as factory methods for generating corresponding events.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface extending a generic builder for handling responses and events related to a specific modify command.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command response objects indicating creation, modification, or errors regarding feature property modification.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating events triggered by the modify feature property command, such as created or modified events.
